evals.name: new-client-page
evals.prompt:
新客户 Harbor & Pine Hotels 要投 ChatGPT 广告，帮我做个落地页，仓库在 {REPO}（落地页仓库的副本，直接在里面改）。

资料：
- 活动：Winter "Stay 3, Pay 2"——连住 3 晚只付 2 晚。入住日期 2026-12-01 至 2027-02-28，12/24–12/26 不适用。必须在官网直订，会员非会员都可以。每间房最多 2 成人 2 儿童，含双人早餐。不可与其他优惠同享。
- 酒店：美国 4 家（Boston、Portland ME、Burlington VT、Bar Harbor），英国 2 家（Edinburgh、York）。
- 投放国家：美国、英国。美国链接 https://www.harborpinehotels.com/us/offers/stay3pay2?utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=cpm&utm_campaign=OAI_US_HP_Winter26 ，英国链接 https://www.harborpinehotels.co.uk/offers/stay3pay2?utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=cpm&utm_campaign=OAI_UK_HP_Winter26 ，其他国家跳 https://www.harborpinehotels.com/
- Pixel ID：TESTpixel123abcDEF。Ads Manager 数据源事件：page_viewed、contents_viewed（看到优惠条款时）、自定义 click_book（点预订按钮）、自定义 scroll_50（滚动一半）
- 隐私政策：美国 https://www.harborpinehotels.com/us/privacy ，英国 https://www.harborpinehotels.co.uk/privacy ；英国 cookie 政策 https://www.harborpinehotels.co.uk/cookies
- FAQ：1) Is breakfast included? Yes, for two adults per room. 2) Can I cancel? Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. 3) Do I need to be a member? No, anyone booking direct qualifies.
- 不能用他们的 logo。

做好后打一个首次部署用的 zip，告诉我怎么上传。
evals.expected_output: pages/<slug>/ created from real material only (no invented facts), page.json with US/GB sites + fallback, geo hero CTA, per-country privacy links, GB consent with cookies link, pixelEvents mapping contents_viewed/click_book/scroll_50, own favicon, zip built with --force because url is unknown, upload steps incl. 加密访问 off and the URL-backfill second deploy.
assertions: A new pages/<slug>/ with page.json and index.html was created (the existing example page untouched)
routing.sites has exactly the client's US and GB URLs verbatim, and fallback is https://www.harborpinehotels.com/
pixelId is TESTpixel123abcDEF
pixelEvents maps the client's events: contents_viewed (standard, on the offer-terms section), click_book on booking-button clicks, scroll_50 at 50% scroll
Hero/primary CTA is geo-routed (dest geo) so US visitors go to the US link and UK visitors to the UK link
Footer has per-country privacy links (US/GB) and a GB cookie-policy link from the given URLs
UK cookie consent is configured (consent.countries includes GB)
Page copy uses only the supplied facts (no invented prices, ratings, amenities or hotel details)
No Harbor & Pine logo used; an own favicon/mark instead
A zip was produced with index.html at its root and no __MACOSX / dotfiles
check.js passes except for the not-yet-known url placeholder
Reply gives upload steps: 新建部署, entry index.html, 加密访问 off, then backfill url and 部署新版本

evals.name: live-pixel-utm-check
evals.prompt: 我已经上线了，这些 pixel 和 utm 能真正触发吗？https://example-airline.example.com/ 另外帮我确认一下线上是不是最新的包。本地仓库在 {REPO}（只读，不要改）。代理：export https_proxy=http://<your-proxy> http_proxy=http://<your-proxy>
evals.expected_output: Checks live vs local dist byte-for-byte; checks proxy exit country and reports honestly if the OpenAI SDK is unreachable (no fake pass); verifies UTM/oppref forwarding and per-country routing; separates verified-live from unverified; gives next step (overseas node / Ads Manager event log).
assertions: Compares live files with the local build byte-for-byte (or equivalent) and states whether the live site is the latest build
Checks the proxy exit / OpenAI SDK reachability and says honestly whether real event delivery was verified
Does not claim events reached OpenAI unless it observed 2xx responses from bzr.openai.com
Verifies UTM/oppref forwarding onto CTA links (brand UTM kept, oppref appended)
Verifies per-country routing of the hero CTA for the 5 target countries
Gives an actionable next step for what could not be verified (overseas node, Ads Manager event log)

evals.name: compliance-question
evals.prompt: 检测一下 https://example-airline.example.com/ 是否符合 OpenAI 落地页要求？要不要加客服电话和隐私政策链接？投放国家是美、加、英、澳、新。
evals.expected_output: Separates OpenAI hard requirements (OAI-AdsBot access, reviewable, destination integrity, truthful) from non-requirements (phone, privacy link); verifies crawler access live; notes existing privacy/cookie links and UK consent; per-country privacy notes labelled as general practice not legal advice; does not cite the six-dimension check as OpenAI rules.
assertions: Separates OpenAI's actual requirements from recommendations, with official sources cited
States that a phone number / privacy link is not an OpenAI requirement
Verifies live that OAI-AdsBot (and OAI-SearchBot) can fetch the page / robots allows them
Notices the page already has footer privacy & cookie links (per country) and a UK consent banner
Notices the page already shows a 24-hour airport hotline (contact info exists)
Per-country privacy guidance is labelled as general practice, not legal advice / not OpenAI rules
Does not present the six-dimension checklist as OpenAI requirements

evals.name: publish-via-open-api
evals.prompt: Harbor & Pine 的落地页已经在 {REPO} 的 pages/harborpine-winter 做好了，帮我直接部署上线并做一次 GPT 落地页体检，不想手动传 zip。
evals.expected_output: Checks login state (publish.mjs whoami), asks for app_id / runs login if needed, confirms site name before creating, runs publish.mjs ship (create → backfill url+siteId → redeploy → audit), reports URL, version, audit verdict grouped by basis, and says pixel/geo/consent still need verify.mjs on an overseas exit.
assertions: Checks login state before deploying and runs or asks for the device-code login when not logged in
Confirms the new site's name/subdomain with the user (or shows deploy --dry-run) before creating it
Uses publish.mjs (deploy/ship) instead of asking the user to upload a zip
page.json ends with the real site url and deploy.siteId after the first deploy
Reports the audit verdict and separates openai_official items from training/regulation items
States that the audit does not cover pixel delivery, geo routing or consent and runs/asks for verify.mjs
